name: Workshop Packager
summary: Create a private full Workshop ZIP or a scanned public-safe package without uploading anything.
notes: Packages are written under exports/workshop-packages. Public-safe mode excludes private folders and sensitive-looking files, performs a secret-pattern scan, and refuses output on findings. An AI-native maintenance drill restores each new archive temporarily, verifies hashes and AXM, proves the restored Hub starts, records evidence, and removes the test copy.
